meta.name: generate-image
meta.description: Generate or edit images with AI models through the OpenRouter Image API (Gemini, Seedream, Recraft, GPT-Image, Riverflow). Use for photos, illustrations, artwork, concept art, visual assets, logos, and image editing or compositing from reference images. For flowcharts, circuits, pathways, and other technical diagrams, use the scientific-schematics skill instead.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用文字描述生成图像,或基于参考图编辑合成新图
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把文字想象变成图片素材,或对已有图片做编辑合成
copy.tagline_en: Generate images from text prompts, or edit and composite photos using reference images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn text descriptions into images or edit photos without design software.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude能按你的文字生成或修改图片,结果存为PNG;它会检查OpenRouter API密钥,缺失时会提示配置,并支持选用不同模型。
howto.when: 当你要求生成/修改照片、插画、概念图等通用图片,或要基于参考图合成时触发;若涉及流程图、电路图等技术图表,则改用 scientific-schematics。

say.text: 生成一张夕阳下的山脉照片
say.note: 会调用脚本生成图,存成 PNG。

say.text: 把这张图片的天空改成紫色
say.note: 以该图作为输入做编辑。

say.text: 用 flux.2-pro 画一只太空猫
say.note: 会切换为该模型再生成。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can call OpenRouter image models to generate images from text or edit existing ones, saving results as PNG. It checks for an OpenRouter API key and supports choosing different models.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to generate or edit general images (photos, illustrations, concept art, etc.) or composite from reference images. For flowcharts, circuits, or other technical diagrams, the scientific-schematics skill is used instead.

say_en.text: Generate a photo of a mountain sunset
say_en.note: Calls the script and saves a PNG.

say_en.text: Change the sky in this image to purple
Draw a space cat using flux.2-pro
say_en.note: Switches to that model for generation.
